instruction: Examine the spreadsheet on the desktop containing book reading records from 2022. Based on the reading pace data (words per day), identify the book that was read at the fastest pace. Open the empty document 'book_list_result.docx' on the desktop and write the title of this fastest-reading book there.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
